title: Test named 'does not match main by literal substring -- mainbranch is not the m…
description:
Test named 'does not match main by literal substring -- mainbranch is not the main token' lives inside the 'frozen-comparand rule: flagged forms' describe and asserts not.toBeNull(). The assertion is correct (mainbranch must not count as a live main token, so the criterion IS flagged), but the 'does not match' phrasing reads as a negative/passing case and momentarily inverts the reader's expectation. Consider renaming to something like 'flags a mainbranch: ref, which is not the main token'.
